content:
The marketing strategy focuses on reaching customers through digital advertising and social media.
Target audience: College students and young professionals ages 18–30.
Marketing channels:
- Instagram advertisements
- Google Search advertising
- Email newsletters
- Referral programs
Goal: Increase website traffic by 20% over three months.
Next step: Compare advertising costs and develop a monthly campaign budget.
